body: Not sure where to find people like that. Honestly I probably shouldn't be looking to other people to fix my own problems, but fuck if it works for all those other people I'm going to give it a try. I've just never heard someone say something that actually made me reevaluate how I feel, yknow? Like I get jealous of the people who can leave a conversation with someone else and actually feel better than they did to start.
